note.en: A pheasant snail under 1 cm with a glossy, patterned shell. Collected at Manzanillo, Punta Mona and Cahuita (1999 to 2000). Tiny and rarely noticed.
note.es: Un caracol faisán de menos de 1 cm con concha lisa y con dibujos. Recolectado en Manzanillo, Punta Mona y Cahuita (1999 a 2000). Diminuto y rara vez se nota.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
